word-grandparents.def: the mothers and fathers of your mom and dad

word-grandson.def: the son of your son or daughter

word-granddaughter.def: the daughter of your son or daughter

word-cousin-male.def: a boy or man whose mom or dad is the brother or sister of your mom or dad

word-cousin-female.def: a girl or woman whose mom or dad is the brother or sister of your mom or dad

word-nephew.def: the son of your brother or sister

word-niece.def: the daughter of your brother or sister

word-bride.def: a woman who is getting married or has just got married

word-groom.def: a man who is getting married or has just got married

word-couple.def: two people who are married or in a romantic relationship

word-divorce.def: the legal end of a marriage

word-get-divorced.def: to end your marriage in a legal way

word-engagement.def: a formal promise to marry someone, or the time before the wedding

word-stepfather.def: the man who is married to your mother but is not your father

word-stepmother.def: the woman who is married to your father but is not your mother

word-only-child.def: a son or daughter with no brothers or sisters

word-raise-child.def: to take care of a young person until he or she is grown up
